setup: Reflect every caller-created textual strong value and exercise Create with valid, null, empty, whitespace, and padded input.
assertion: Only a private constructor and Create(string) exist; invalid text fails before persistence and sibling value types are not interchangeable.
expectedRed: The exact application strong-value families are not implemented.

setup: Reflect every runtime-created identity and its parser/converter round trip.
assertion: No public constructor or Create exists; canonical nonempty parsing works and Guid.Empty is rejected.

setup: Call DefinitionId.New repeatedly and parse/try-parse Guid.Empty.
assertion: New is always nonempty; Parse rejects empty and TryParse returns false with null output.
expectedRed: The final DefinitionId reference-value contract is absent.

setup: Round-trip each supported value graph through codec orcacore-json-v1 under stable member and collection order.
assertion: Bytes and type fidelity are deterministic, detached, null-safe, and unsupported/cyclic/polymorphic shapes fail before commit; no codec replacement seam exists.
expectedRed: The certified fixed codec is not implemented.

setup: Build definitions with equal structure but changed opaque delegates, then with an explicit version bump.
assertion: Fingerprint includes structural contracts only; opaque code changes require a version bump and never serialize delegate identity.
expectedRed: The final structural fingerprint/version policy is absent.

setup: Mutate attempt-local StepContext state, fail/retry, and use ReplaceState on success.
assertion: Failed attempts leak no mutation; successful commit uses the detached replacement and does not expose mutable committed state.
expectedRed: Attempt-local state and ReplaceState are provisional.

setup: Reflect and exercise ReadOnlyStateSnapshot<TState> across author selectors.
assertion: It is a runtime-created non-positional reference type with no public construction and a detached Value.
expectedRed: The exact snapshot shape is absent.

setup: Complete resultless and resultful workflows and reopen their typed handles.
assertion: Fixed outcome metadata and typed output remain distinct and require no cast.
expectedRed: Typed completion definitions and handles are absent.

setup: Read application snapshots/state/output while branches, items, attempts, and waits are active.
assertion: Only detached committed root state, typed output, fixed outcome, and authored active-wait data are visible; private state, compiled plans, fiber/scope ownership, running deadline, attempt, and in-flight facts are absent.
